spec_theorems.name: run_stdout_eq_uniqLines
spec_theorems.informal: The stdout produced by the model is precisely the input lines with each adjacent run of equal lines collapsed to one line.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: In the no-option standard-input/standard-output scope, the utility completes successfully with exit status 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_stdout_noAdjacent
spec_theorems.informal: After processing, the output contains no equal neighboring lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_length_le_input
spec_theorems.informal: Filtering adjacent duplicates never increases the number of output lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_lines_from_input
spec_theorems.informal: Every line written to output is one of the original input lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_idempotent
spec_theorems.informal: Applying the same adjacent-duplicate collapse to the output again leaves it unchanged.
